body: Nobody came. There was no cancellation and no message, and the seat that was described to you stayed empty.
Ruslan finds out on the Thursday that the man has not worked there since March.

choices.outcome_text: He is quiet for a second, which is new. He says he should have checked and he does not make anything up.
He has eleven other clients and two of them are eighteen. You have known that for years.

body: The one who knew you from Kalach is gone by the time you get there. He lasted eight games.
The caretaker has your name on a sheet with nineteen others and is honest that he does not know which of you is which.

choices.text: Tell him which one you are.
choices.outcome_text: He writes something next to your name. You do not get close enough to see what.
The session runs long and he is called away before the end of it.

items.notes: 08 §8: the death of football beyond the Urals as a travel problem.

body: It is eleven hours each way and the club will not cover it. You can do it once.
They want to see you three times. There is no version of the arithmetic where three works.

choices.text: Go once and hope it is enough.
choices.outcome_text: You play the eleven hours back over in your head for a week. They wanted three.

choices.text: Tell them you cannot make the dates.
choices.outcome_text: They are understanding about it. Being understood is not the same as being seen.

items.notes: 08 §8: clubs that vanish, and the towns that keep the fixtures anyway.

body: Their sponsor is the plant and the plant has gone to a four-day week.
They are not signing anybody. They are working out how to finish the season with the squad they have.

choices.text: Say you would come for expenses.
choices.outcome_text: He says he cannot register anybody at all, at any number, and he shows you why.
They finish the season. In the summer the fixture list comes out without them on it.

body: Everything held. The scout came, the money was there, the medical passed, the forms went in on time.
You are twenty-eight and you played the way you play, and it is a level below where they are.

choices.text: Ask him to be straight with you.
choices.outcome_text: He is. It takes him one sentence and he does not soften it, and you shake his hand for it.
He looks relieved. In the car park you sit for a while before you start the engine.
